audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 fits 48.46% WR over 1921 games: Ryze bullies early, Vladimir out-scales the duel late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart disagreed with content/packet on rows 0, 1, 4 and 6 (full carried Skill where content/packet say Ryze, Ryze, Vladimir, Vladimir).
audit.why: Content and packet agree; Vladimir is weakest levels 1-3 (Q 9s cooldown, no health stacked) and strongest at 6+ (Hemoplague + 2s untargetable Sanguine Pool) and late (health stacking + R amp).
audit.corrected: Sides aligned with matching why and rating rewrites; win[] already correct so no content chart edits.

audit.whatIsWrong: tldr/report[0] claimed 'he out-ranges your combo for five levels' — false: Ryze Q is 1000 range, Vladimir Q is 600. No field noted that Tides of Blood is blocked by minions, and Grievous Wounds timing (missing-interactions rule needs-antiheal) appeared only as one clause in itemization.
audit.why: Kit ranges: Ryze Q 1000/W-E 615 vs Vladimir Q 600/E 600/W 350. Vladimir E text: 'can be blocked by enemy units'. Q and R both flagged heal.
audit.corrected: tldr and report[0] rewritten to the real range direction; minion-block added to breakdown.early; Oblivion Orb timing added to spikes[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1].d referenced 'a Zed mark' in a Vladimir matchup.

edits.before: He out-ranges your combo for five levels — farm the Tear, dodge the big spell, and let the item curve flip the lane.
edits.after: You out-range him early — Q is 1000 to his 600. Bully before his sustain scales, then let items keep you level.

edits.before: He out-ranges your combo for five levels — farm the Tear, dodge the big spell, and let the item curve flip the lane.
edits.after: You out-range him early — Q is 1000 to his 600. Bully before his sustain scales, then let items keep you level.

edits.before: Q-farm at max range — your level 1 is honest at best. Bank Tear stacks and give nothing away.
edits.after: Your 1000-range Q outreaches his Transfusion — trade freely at his weakest level and bank stacks.

edits.before: W online: the point-blank root answers anyone who closes. Trade Q-W-Q only when his engage tool is down.
edits.after: W online and his Transfusion is still 9s — Q-W-Q him each time his Q is down; he cannot answer back yet.

edits.before: Realm Warp online — you are now a map play waiting to happen. The lane is a timer: shove and warp somewhere profitable.
edits.after: His 6 beats yours in lane: Hemoplague plus a 2s pool dodge heal through your burst. Shove and warp elsewhere instead.

edits.before: Two items and you ARE the win condition: EQ deletes carries, W stops divers, and Realm Warp turns objectives into ambushes.
edits.after: He out-scales the duel — health stacking and R amp make him unkillable 1v1. Warp for picks and fight him 5v5 instead.

edits.before: Farm the Tear, hold the root, dodge the headline spell. Ryze early is a savings account — deposits only.
edits.after: Bully levels 1-3 — his Tides of Blood is blocked by minions, so trade from behind the wave and hold your root.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Rune Prison like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sanguine Pool: 28s at rank 1, 16s max — untargetable for 2s; bait it and his kill window is yours for most of half a minute. - Transfusion: 9s early, 4.6s max — trade while it is down. - Your ultimate goes to kill windows only.

edits.before: E the wave, Q the flux bounce, and W-root if he steps to answer — three-spell trades that end before his combo starts.
edits.after: Tides of Blood costs his own health and is 13s at rank 1 — when he E-clears the wave, the Q-E answer costs him twice.

edits.before: Your root is your only 'stop' button — a W spent poking is a Zed mark you can't answer.
edits.after: Your root is your only 'stop' button — hold it for the step-up after his pool is spent.

edits.before: Spending W on poke and then face-tanking the engage it was born to stop — rootless Ryze is a Tear with a health bar.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool is 28s at rank 1 — the root you hold for its downtime is worth more than any poke W thrown into it.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP doubles the thesis. Nothing else is defensible on him.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP extends the map game. Nothing else is defensible on him.

edits.before: Level 6 flips to Vladimir: Hemoplague (R) plus his Sanguine Pool (W) untargetable dodge let him survive your burst and heal it all back, so a straight all-in now trades poorly. Poke him with Q-E on the wave instead of committing into his pool-and-heal combo.
edits.after: Level 6 flips to Vladimir: Hemoplague (R) plus his Sanguine Pool (W) untargetable dodge let him survive your burst and heal it back, so a straight all-in trades poorly. Grab an early Oblivion Orb and poke with Q-E rather than committing into his pool-heal combo.
